semantics: Documentation graphs, not executable n8n workflows. Edges are process/data-flow compositions supported by references; planned edges are proposals.
title: Refund processing
subtitle: Captured payment verification, refund balance and provider-confirmed result

nodes.label: Owner requests refund
nodes.description: Payments UI verifies provider payment before refunding.

nodes.label: POST admin payments
nodes.description: Owner authorization, origin, rate limit and refund input checks.

nodes.label: Refundable captured payment?
nodes.description: Verify provider capture, currency, amount, remaining refundable balance and idempotent refund identity.

nodes.label: Record Processing refund
nodes.description: Embedded orders.refunds[] and audit entry record the intent before provider execution.

nodes.label: Razorpay Refunds API
nodes.description: Gateway may report processed, failed or still processing; ambiguous responses remain unresolved. Runtime configuration and connectivity are Unverified.

nodes.label: Signed refund webhook
nodes.description: Verified Razorpay refund event reaches processRefundWebhook.

nodes.label: Reconcile remote refund
nodes.description: Refund identity, order association, amount and event status are validated.

nodes.label: Refunded / Failed / Processing
nodes.description: Persist only provider-confirmed status; audit and cancellation reconciliation follow.

nodes.label: Provider refund status
nodes.description: Owner and account views use recorded provider refund status.

nodes.label: Request failed
nodes.description: Validation, access, conflict or service errors are returned to the caller. Status and error shape depend on the specific route.

nodes.label: Show error / retry
nodes.description: Failure end state. Caller receives the actual error; a retry may be offered by the UI.

notes: Source implementation is documented; deployed configuration and provider connectivity are not verified.
Manual returns approval is separate from gateway refund execution. Automated PayPal and Stripe refund execution was not found; a future implementation is Planned.
